verses.gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਂਡ ਜਾਂ ਕੇ ਏਕ ਰੋਮ ਅਗ੍ਰਭਾਗਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਤਾਸ ਕਹਾ ਧੌ ਸਮਾਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: koT brahamaa(n)dd jaa(n) ke ek rom agrabhaag pooran pragaas taas kahaa dhau samaaviee ||

en.bdb: The Lord who has millions of Universes existing in the tip of His each hair, to what extent is His complete radiance spread?

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਾਂ ਕੇ ਏਕ ਤਿਲ ਕੋ ਮਹਾਤਮ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਜੋਤਿ ਕੈਸੇ ਕਹਿ ਆਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaa(n) ke ek til ko mahaatam agaadh bodh pooran braham jot kaise keh aaviee ||

en.bdb: The Lord-significance of whose marvellous and wonderful radiance equal to a sesame seed is beyond description, how can His complete light be described?

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੇ ਓਅੰਕਾਰ ਕੇ ਬਿਥਾਰ ਕੀ ਅਪਾਰ ਗਤਿ ਸਬਦ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਏਕ ਜੀਹ ਕੈਸੇ ਗਾਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaa ke oa(n)kaar ke bithaar kee apaar gat sabadh bibek ek jeeh kaise gaaviee ||

en.bdb: The Lord whose complete extent and expanse is infinite, how can a tongue describe His divine word and His divine form the True Guru?

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰ ਮਹਮਾ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਨੇਤਿ ਨੇਤਿ ਨੇਤਿ ਨਮੋ ਨਮੋ ਕਰਿ ਆਵਈ ॥੨੭੦॥
verses.translit_en: pooran braham gur mahamaa akath kathaa net net net namo namo kar aaviee ||270||

en.bdb: Praise and panegyrics of the True Guru who is an image of the complete Lord is beyond mention and elucidation. The best way to express one's love and respect for Him is to salute Him again and again while addressing Him- "0 Lord, Master! You are infinite, infinite." (270)
